questions.stem: A 45-year-old female complains of morning stiffness lasting over an hour and pain in her hands and wrists. On examination, there is swelling and tenderness of multiple small joints in her hands. Laboratory results show a positive rheumatoid factor (RF) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP) antibodies. X-ray reveals soft tissue swelling and early joint space narrowing. Which of the following joint involvement patterns is most characteristic of this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Symmetrical involvement of small joints, particularly the MCP and PIP joints

options.label: B
options.text: Asymmetrical involvement of small joints, particularly the MCP and PIP joints

options.label: C
options.text: Symmetrical involvement of the DIP joints

options.label: D
options.text: Asymmetrical involvement of the DIP joints
